description: The OSM surveyor describes it only as a "MIG"; on the balance of what was plinthed in Kazakh town parks this is most likely a MiG-15 or MiG-17 but the source does not say and no designation is asserted here; the memorial is dedicated to aviators who took part in the Great Patriotic War
museum_name: Aviators of the Great Patriotic War Memorial -- Shymkent
